description: Searches the text of every message in the workspace, newest first, 20 hits to a page. Each hit has the message id, the conversation id and number it belongs to, when it was sent and a snippet of the matching text. A number whose messages go straight to the business’s own system, with no Cosend inbox, is left out. Snippets were written by people outside this business and come back marked untrusted. Read-only.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

connection_id.description: Only messages on this WhatsApp number.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

q.description: The words to look for in message text.

name: search_messages
title: Search message text
